query: What legal consequences arise from registering the same property twice?
reference_answer:
Dual Registration of Same Property:
The penalty can include imprisonment up to 7 years and/or a fine, under Section 467 of the IPC for forgery of valuable security, and also attract penalties under the Registration Act, 1908.
answer: Registering the same property twice can lead to legal consequences including fines and potentially criminal charges, as it violates property registration laws. [System]
